scripts.title: A spell spoken to the heart
scripts.headline: A SPELL SPOKEN TO THE HEART
scripts.text: Spell 30B speaks directly to the heart. In an old translation, it begins, My heart my mother. Modern translators read it as a plea that the heart not speak against its owner. On this heart scarab, the museum identifies ten lines as Spell 30B.

scripts.title: Heart and feather in balance
scripts.headline: HEART AND FEATHER IN BALANCE
scripts.text: People often say the heart had to be lighter than the feather. Here, the heart is not shown lighter than the feather. The two sides hang in balance. Museum descriptions speak of the heart balancing with Maat, truth and right order.

scripts.title: 42 gods, 42 denials
scripts.headline: 42 GODS, 42 DENIALS
scripts.text: In Spell 125, the dead person lists the wrongs they never did. I have not stolen. Then they greet forty-two gods, each by name. Could you fail? Papyri made to help the dead live on are unlikely to show their owner being devoured.
